programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Celia Imrie revisits one of cinema's greatest decades with a deeper dig into the BBC archives, uncovering more revealing interviews and magic movie moments from 1970s Hollywood. From a teenage Linda Blair shrugging off the revulsion that had movie-goers' heads spinning with The Exorcist, to Clint Eastwood's hippy-sounding relaxation techniques at the time of Dirty Harry, this is the story of the movie icons who were setting new standards in acting and directing 50 years ago.

programme.title: Taxi Driver
programme.desc: New York City cab driver Travis Bickle constantly reflects on the ugly corruption of life around him, and becomes increasingly disturbed over his own loneliness and alienation. In nearly every phase of his life, Bickle remains a complete outsider, failing to make emotional contact with anyone. Unable to sleep night after night, Travis haunts the local pornography emporiums to find diversion.

programme.title: Funeral in Berlin

programme.title: Becoming Frida Kahlo
programme.desc: Frida and Diego travel to San Francisco where he has an important mural commission. Frida's style stirs much excitement, and she is determined to succeed in her own right in the face of Diego's affairs. Shocked by the vast gap between rich and poor that she witnesses in Depression-era New York, she struggles to hide her disdain for high society. After losing a child to miscarriage and her mother to illness, she produces some of her most visceral and devastating works.

programme.desc: This episode is about calming down in the kitchen, with slow-cook recipes from Nigella that are perfect for weekend dinner parties, including 24-hour aromatic pork.

programme.title: Nigella Bites
programme.desc: In this edition, Nigella Bites prepares a number of suppertime favourites to suit all tastes including lamb shanks with couscous, raw salmon with ginger and rice vinegar and mouthwatering creme brulee.

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie dresses a salad in a way you've never seen before. He's also got a speedy, tasty twist on our Sunday roast that keeps it all in one pan. Plus: YouTube sensation Alex Aïnouz shares his five-ingredient take on a French classic.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Ina makes a french movie inspired meal for her Wednesday night film buddies. They rent the movie and Ina makes a tasty meal of chicken with garlic cloves and Moroccan cous cous, rounded off with a sweet ice cream bomb.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Ina makes lunch for a team of burly builders. To keep up their strength, Ina feeds them mini meatloaves with buttercream mashed potatoes, Brussels sprouts and lardons. For dessert - a wickedly delicious brownie pie.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: It's bread week in the tent and the bakers must create quick breads for the signature challenge. The technical challenge is baguettes and for the showstopper, the bakers must make edible 3D Bread sculptures.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: There's nine bakers left in the tent and the signature challenge is a French classic - creme brulee. The technical challenge tasks the bakers with making a Spanische windtorte and the showstopper calls for a stack of tiered cheesecakes.

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel visits a free-range farm and is inspired to cook a delicious guinea fowl dish. Plus, he reveals his quick and easy croque monsieur recipe.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shows that spicy food isn't all about hot chillis. Using a range of everyday spices, he creates a week's worth of tasty dishes that will appeal to everyone. Thai spiced aubergines, chilli feta and a quick korma are all simple dishes that combine warm and hearty spices, but don't burn your mouth. Nigel also visits Liverpool to visit allotment holders Rachel and Paul.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shows how to make simple delicious feasts out of ingredients that at first seem to have seen better days. Stale bread, brown bananas and hard cheese are all transformed to make meals that are truly delicious. Nigel's cheese puddings, banana and chocolate cake and bacon and squash pan fry are all guaranteed to make mouths water.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
